name: Pudu Robotics
summary: Pudu Robotics develops and manufactures commercial service robots. Built around mobility, manipulation and AI, it pioneered a 'one brain, multiple forms' architecture and established a complete portfolio of specialized, semi-humanoid and humanoid robots. Pudu has four product lines: delivery, cleaning, industrial and general-purpose embodied intelligence. Its products are used in retail, hotels, industry, warehousing and logistics, food service, property cleaning, healthcare, entertainment and sports, education, public transport and public services. Its business spans more than 80 countries, with cumulative shipments exceeding 120,000 units.
